title: Dilation invariance of rectifiable triples
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ, let ρ ∈ ℝ with ρ > 0, M ⊆ ℝ^N, θ : ℝ^N → ℝ and ξ : ℝ^N → NVector(ℝ^N, k). Put φ(x) := ρ • x, μ := H^k = μHE[k] and c := ENNReal.ofReal(ρ^k). Assume (H1) φ is a measurable embedding and (H2) φ is measure preserving from c • μ to μ. If (M, θ, ξ) is a rectifiable triple in ℝ^N (IsRectifiableTriple univ k M θ ξ), then so is (φ(M), θ(ρ⁻¹·), ξ(ρ⁻¹·)). In Lean: IsRectifiableTriple univ k ((fun x => ρ • x) '' M) (fun y => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) (fun y => ξ (ρ⁻¹ • y)).
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (M : Set (Eucl N)) (θ : Eucl N → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k), 0 < ρ → MeasurableEmbedding (fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) → MeasurePreserving (fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) (ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ k) • (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k M θ ξ → IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k ((fun x : Eucl N => ρ • x) '' M) (fun y : Eucl N => θ (ρ⁻¹ • y)) (fun y : Eucl N => ξ (ρ⁻¹ • y))
